# How does Rivo Autopilot manage household cash?

R

Written by Rebecca
Updated over a week ago

Rivo Autopilot monitors your income, expenses, and idle cash in real time. It moves money you are not using into U.S. government-backed assets, and brings it back to your account before bills are due. You can request a withdrawal of your available funds at any time; it may take 1-3 business days for the funds to show up in your external connected account.
